question: Team TS3012's project manager first wanted to drop the LCD screen. What changed his mind, was the LCD in the final design, and what happened to speech recognition?
answer: Speaker A (Project Manager) shifted toward keeping the LCD because the team thought it appealed to the target group, and the final cost discussion cited stronger customer support for LCD (90%) than speech recognition (60%); Speaker B also said speech offered no extra function over a normal remote. The LCD remained in the final design, while speech recognition was scrapped to meet the 12.50 Euros production-cost cap.
